text:
maria: All-hands in 18. Small change: were consolidating to a single-stream output via the CDN to avoid split-audio issues. Presenters please use the wired mic setup in Room F.

lina: Wired mic OK. FYI Room F projector has weird overscan; Ill bring a spare adapter and a test image.

video-ops: CDN pipeline set to single-stream master. Local OBS will still record isolated tracks. If CDN handshake fails, fallback is internal RTMP to ingester-2. Posting checklist now.

kevin: Remote participants  will the Q&A still be live? Im on call but want to jump in if needed.

maria: Yes Q&A live; we've shortened it to 8 min. Any overflow goes to #ask-leaders.

tara: Two small asks: 1) can we disable attendee camera on the stream? 2) can captions be enabled?

video-ops: Attendee cameras disabled at the bridge. Enabling captions now (auto-caption model=en-rt-small). If captions exceed 1.5s lag we'll switch to human captions.

stream-bot: ingester-2 health: OK; cdn-handshake: PENDING -> SUCCESS. backup-rtmp: configured.

devon: Uploading slides: https://drive.redwood/team/all-hands/mar-2026/v2. Please double-check speaker notes. Also adding timestamps to slides for tight timing.

video-ops: Reminder to presenters: mute laptop system sounds and disable notifications. Quick audio recipe: set mixer to "RoomF Line"; gain +6. If you need a USB dongle, ping me.

kevin: Quick technical q: if we hot-swap presenter laptop mid-talk, will the stream stall?

video-ops: Hot-swap strategy: pre-stage video on HDMI switcher input 2; when swapping, cut to a holding slide for 3s, then switch. No more than 6s interruption expected.

maria: Also note: Hiring update is postponed  we'll email a summary. Product roadmap will be high-level only today. Detailed roadmap AMA next month.

lina: Doing mic test now in Room F. @video-ops can you confirm levels?

video-ops: Level looks good at -12dB RMS. Doing a quick record test: ```arecord -f cd -d 3 /tmp/mictest.wav && aplay /tmp/mictest.wav```

stream-bot: recording status: LOCAL_OK, CLOUD_PENDING.

maria: Thanks. If anything goes wrong, post in this thread and well coordinate. Mic check at T-10 in Room F. See you soon. :rocket:
